units: All completion values/differences are fractions0..1. Summary and paired contrasts use3seed means and sampleSD(ddof1).
scope: Independent read-only raw complete/sidecar/evaluation JSON review; checkpoint paths/report links checked but checkpoint tensors were not loaded or rehashed. Root strict reporter separately verifies full checkpoint bytes and semantic states.
interpretation: There is partial familiar-A accumulation in several arms, visible in improved A scores after later B visits; the trajectories are not uniformly monotonic. Across all selected modes, B endpoints mostly oscillate or plateau rather than demonstrating cumulative mastery of both regimes.

BP replay preserves A across B visits much better than BP64, while their B endpoints remain in a similar broad range. The frozen old bank contains only original A experience and is never refreshed with revisited B history. This asymmetry is a structural advantage for A retention, not evidence for a general symmetric lifelong-memory solution.

Symmetric diagonal credit improves familiar A endpoints across visits but retains weak B performance; replay stabilizes A at a higher level without broad B accumulation. The selected five cycle arms do not show an across-visit score collapse, but the random-feedback/shuffle/reset controls were not cycle arms, so that observation cannot be generalized to them.

Higher raw1024 A scores on later visits are insufficient to claim faster reacquisition: previous B-end A baselines generally improve as well. Baseline-adjusted visit4-minus-visit2 early gains are reported per seed. Only1024 and4096tick measurements exist; these do not identify a full learning-rate curve.

Readout-only reacquires familiar A strongly but retains weak B scores. This shows that some improvements are possible by changing the existing head on pretrained continuous features; it does not prove richer recurrent temporal credit.

All primary cycle forks use the same CPU measurement backend and512steps. Cross-endpoint future cases and own histories still differ, so paired changes are paired by training seed, not by identical requests or action trajectories.

The initial main endpoint has2048tick evaluation rather than512. It is not used as a numerical baseline for the first A switch. For later switches, the immediately preceding4096tick endpoint supplies the same512tick condition baseline.

One seed is one replicate(n=3), with sampleSD across paired seed differences. Actors, requests, milestones, four visits and448preserved auxiliary CUDA forks are not additional independent training replicates.

A/B are familiar versions of the same task, with future-contract regime changes and inherited live states. Reacquisition and retention here do not prove new-task plasticity or a causal loss-of-plasticity mechanism.
This review makes no inference that saturation, parameter growth or tangent decay causes a performance change. No new rollout, optimizer step or checkpoint/state sampling was performed.
